Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. Call (478) 447-3586 and we'll talk through the job and give you a straightforward price before any work begins.

What areas do you serve?

We're based at 612 Childers Dr in Warner Robins and serve homes and businesses throughout Warner Robins and the surrounding Middle Georgia area.

Is it safe to wait if a breaker keeps tripping?

A breaker that trips repeatedly is your electrical panel telling you something's wrong — it's worth having an electrician look at it before it becomes a bigger problem.

Do you work on both residential and commercial properties?

Yes — from single-family homes to commercial buildings, we handle both.

Do you install EV chargers?

Yes, including Tesla wall chargers — see our EV Charger Installation service above.

What are your hours?

Monday–Friday, 8am–4:30pm. Give us a call at (478) 447-3586 and we'll do our best to help.
